shortDescription: A German branch of the Iranian state-owned lender Sepah Bank has been declared insolvent in the wake of sanctions, Germany's financial regulator said on Thursday.

children: A German branch of the Iranian state-owned lender Sepah Bank has been declared insolvent in the wake of sanctions, Germany's financial regulator said on Thursday.
"The institution is no longer able to repay its customers' deposits," said the BaFin regulator.
The bank's Frankfurt location did not immediately respond to an email seeking comment.
